parts.label: GN Pans (Ingredient Bins)
parts.detail: Gastronorm (GN) pans that keep ingredients organised and within easy reach along the top rail.

parts.label: Pan Holder / Top Rail
parts.detail: Raised stainless rail that seats the GN pans above the worktop.

parts.label: Stainless Steel Worktop
parts.detail: Stainless steel work surface for preparation, sitting on top of the insulated cabinet.

parts.label: Insulation Layer
parts.detail: 60 mm thick polyurethane insulation for better energy efficiency.

parts.label: Cabinet Body (Stainless Steel)
parts.detail: AISI 304 stainless steel internal and external panels.

parts.label: Shelves (Adjustable)
parts.detail: 4 adjustable stainless steel wire mesh shelves.

parts.label: Refrigeration Unit (Compressor, Condenser, Fan)
parts.detail: Forced air circulation gives rapid cooling and an even temperature distribution. Operating temperature is adjustable from -2 C to +10 C; a static-cooling version for -18 C to -20 C is also available.

parts.label: Front Panel (with Controller)
parts.detail: Front panel carrying the controller, with a ventilation grille for the refrigeration unit.

parts.label: Door (with Gasket) - left
parts.detail: Door fitted with a gasket that seals the cabinet.

parts.label: Door (with Gasket) - right
parts.detail: Door fitted with a gasket that seals the cabinet.

parts.label: Adjustable Legs
parts.detail: Adjustable legs for levelling the unit on uneven floors.
